reference_disclaimer: Commit 190984e, offscreen, QFusionStyle, device pixel ratio 1.0. Each capture carries the palette it was taken under in appearance-at-capture.json. These two profiles have shipped since they were written and no rendered frame of either has ever been looked at — they passed the contrast sweep, which is exactly how a white scrollbar survived in the dark profile for as long as dark had no captures. Nothing about them was changed to produce this batch; these are the profiles as they stand.

acceptance_criteria: Added and removed are distinguishable from the pane and from each other
The selected group is obvious, and the tint under it is still readable
The change-group rule reads as a divider
Syntax colouring is readable against every band

audit_verdict.note: Every pair meets the 7.00:1 high-contrast text minimum. Selection distance 16.6 from the pane, above both accepted profiles.

subjects.description: The first rendered frame of this profile. Nothing was changed to make it — this is what ships. The selection is yellow, so a selected removed line reads orange and a selected added line reads yellow-green. The change-group rule is solid black here rather than the grey used in light and dark, because this profile inverts the pair the rule picks from.

detail_sections.heading: Measured
items: Selection distance from the pane: high-contrast light 16.6, high-contrast dark 12.5. Accepted light is 12.5 and accepted dark 14.2, so both of these are at or above what you approved.
Text is held to 7.00:1 in these profiles against 4.50 in the other two, and every pair passes.
The change-group rule resolves to the header background here rather than the header text, because these profiles invert that pair. That branch had never been rendered before these frames.

subjects.display_name: High contrast light: never before seen
known_concerns: Selecting a line shifts its colour a long way — pink to orange, green to yellow-green — rather than tinting it. Judge whether the change kind is still legible under the selection.
syntax_warning and syntax_error have owed a non-colour signal in this profile since it was written; no such signal exists yet.
diff_intraline_added_background was lightened slightly during earlier work to clear a contrast failure the old model hid. That is the only value here that has moved.
